title: Server errors in the part dialog show the failure messages
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919). The Admin role has 'Part Library & Inventory → View / Create & Edit / Delete'.
  • Inventory part {Part-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-SRVERRDLG-01) is active at {Location-A}, on no work order, with no open return.
custom_steps:
1. In the top bar click Parts, then click Inventory in the left menu.
  2. Type {Part-A} in the Search box.
  3. Click the {Part-A} row.
  4. Change Sell Price to 25.00.
  5. Click Save.
  6. Click the {Part-A} row.
  7. Pick Part Status → Inactive.
  8. Click Save.
  9. Click Deactivate in the "Deactivate part?" confirmation.
  10. Click the Inactive tab.
  11. Type {Part-A} in the Search box, replacing any text there.
  12. Click the {Part-A} row.
  13. Click Delete Part.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 5: When the system answers normally the part is saved. On a server failure a red message "Failed to save part." with "Please try again." fades after about 3 seconds.
  • Step 9: When the system answers normally a green toast reads "Part deactivated.". On a server failure a red message "Failed to set this part inactive" with "Please try again or contact support for help" fades after about 7 seconds.
  • Step 13: When the system answers normally the part is deleted and the dialog closes, with no confirmation. On a server failure a red message "Failed to delete part." with "Please try again." fades after about 3 seconds.
  • Steps 5, 9 and 13: A server failure cannot be caused from the screen: write "server-error messages not checked by hand" in the result comment.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10826 (Story 13, The Part Dialog); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, v29 (14 Oct 2026 copy), S13-R22, S13-R26, §8 User Feedback Summary, read 14 Oct 2026; design canvas board 3.3 (Save asks first), board 3.4 (Done), 13 Oct copy. Source-verified 14 October 2026; not yet build-verified (no Part Lifecycle QA build exists).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • PRD §8 User Feedback Summary (Part save fails (server error)): “"Failed to save part." with "Please try again." | Error toast, fades after 3 seconds”
  • PRD §8 User Feedback Summary (Status change from the part dialog fails (server error)): “"Failed to set this part inactive" / "Failed to set this part active", with "Please try again or contact support for help" | Error toast, fades after 7 seconds”
  • PRD §8 User Feedback Summary (Part delete fails (server error)): “"Failed to delete part." with "Please try again." | Error toast, fades after 3 seconds”
  • PRD §8 User Feedback Summary (Part deactivated from the part dialog): “"Part deactivated." | Success toast, fades on its own”
  • S13-R26: “Delete Part deletes the part and closes the dialog. It asks for no confirmation.”
